# gezor_workspace (Data Source)

Looks up one workspace by id or slug. Without `id`, returns the provider's workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gezor_workspace" "analytics" {
  id = "analytics"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Workspace id or slug to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `is_primary` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `slug` (String)
